name: ccsci
description: ccsci — research & scientific-computing skills adapted from Claude Science for stock Claude Code. Skills: literature-review (DOI-grounded, all-STEM, BibTeX export), bib-audit (verify, correct, upgrade, dedupe, rekey and tidy an existing .bib), pdf-explore (parse-once big-PDF navigation, table extraction, native-resolution figures), figure-style / figure-composer / paper-narrative (publication multi-panel figures), canvas-design (generative poster/art + bundled fonts), doc-coauthoring (guided doc/spec co-writing), web-artifacts-builder (React/shadcn single-file HTML), paper-review (human-driven peer review with Claude as second reader: line-anchored claim ledger, rubric-boundary calibration, error checks on the reviewer's drafts). Plus computational-scientist and deep-researcher subagents.
